conventions.slots: {name} in the string; declare each in the entry's slots map as text|date|measured

strings.verdict.limiting.foundations: What holds your score down most: the foundations — how your site is built and how easily it can be read.
strings.verdict.limiting.answerability: What holds your score down most: answerability — how well your pages answer the questions buyers actually ask.
strings.verdict.limiting.presence: What holds your score down most: presence — how often you appear where buyers look, in Google and in AI answers.
strings.unmeasured.undeterminable: {what} couldn’t be measured — nothing came back that could be read.
strings.unmeasured.not-attempted: {what} wasn’t measured — the scan stopped early, before it got there.
strings.removal.line.on-report: Own this site and want this report taken down? Write to {address}.
strings.removal.line.removed: This report was removed at the site owner’s request. To make {domain} scannable again, write to {address}.
strings.notice.incomplete: This report is incomplete — {what} wasn’t measured.
strings.notice.measurement-failed: The last measurement didn’t finish, so nothing new was stored.
strings.notice.correction-failed: The correction didn’t finish — this is the report from before it.
strings.notice.refused.network-limit: That’s five scans from your network in the last hour — you can scan again in {wait}.
strings.notice.refused.scan-running: A scan is already running from your network. It finishes in about {wait}, then this one can start.
